meta_description: Leicester Plumbing Solutions offers expert plumbing across Leicester. Fast response, reliable repairs, and free quotes. Call today for same-day service.
hero_eyebrow: Trusted Local Plumbers — Free Quotes Available
hero_subhead: Leaking pipes, boiler faults, or blocked drains — we get to you fast and fix it right, first time.
services_subhead: From emergency call-outs to full bathroom installations, we cover every plumbing need for Leicester homes and businesses.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, severe leaks, and sudden plumbing failures handled fast. We aim to reach you within the hour so damage is kept to an absolute minimum.

services.title: Boiler Repairs & Servicing
services.desc: Keep your heating running safely and efficiently with our thorough boiler servicing and repair work. We diagnose faults quickly and carry common parts to get you back up and running the same day.

services.title: Blocked Drains & Toilets
services.desc: Stubborn blockages cleared using professional-grade equipment, not just a plunger. We identify the root cause to prevent the problem returning anytime soon.

services.title: Leak Detection & Repair
services.desc: Hidden leaks can cause serious structural damage if left untreated. We use non-invasive techniques to pinpoint the source and carry out a lasting repair.

services.title: Bathroom Installations
services.desc: From a single tap replacement to a complete bathroom fit-out, our team delivers neat, quality workmanship with minimal disruption to your home.

services.title: Central Heating Systems
services.desc: Radiator installations, power flushing, and full central heating system upgrades carried out by experienced engineers to keep your home warm all year round.

about_pullquote: Every job we take on, we treat as if it's our own home.
about_para_1: Leicester Plumbing Solutions was founded right here in Leicester with a straightforward mission: to provide honest, high-quality plumbing that local residents and businesses can genuinely rely on. Over more than a decade of trading, we have built up a loyal customer base across the city and surrounding areas through consistent, dependable workmanship.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is our commitment to turning up when we say we will, quoting fairly, and leaving every property clean and tidy. Our customers keep coming back — and recommending us to their neighbours — because we never cut corners and always stand behind our work.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Called Leicester Plumbing Solutions after discovering a leak under my kitchen sink on a Monday morning. They were with me within the hour, sorted the problem quickly, and the price was very fair. Absolutely brilliant service — will be using them again.
reviews.author: David H.

reviews.text: Had a completely blocked drain that two other companies failed to fix properly. Leicester Plumbing Solutions came out the same day, cleared it thoroughly, and explained exactly what had caused it. Genuinely impressed with the professionalism.
reviews.author: Karen T.

reviews.text: Booked them in for a full bathroom installation and couldn't be happier with the result. The team were tidy, polite, and finished on time. I've already recommended them to friends and family across Leicester.
reviews.author: Mohammed A.
